notes: Accept, after corrections made in place. The text read is arXiv 2012.12879v4 (SHA-256 f92379be…a07a8, matching the record), the 'final version, to appear' posted two days after acceptance; the published Annals text is not freely served, so the findings are scoped to v4, and sourceVersions now says so in a single preprint entry (collation.py classified the paper as published before). All nine recorded mistakes are confirmed on the page images, including the gap E5 in the proof of Proposition 4.2.12, whose counterexample (N = M trivial, p^j u^{nj} ∈ A_n ∖ pA_n with norm p^{−j}) was rechecked. Five are added (E10–E14): an error in the statement of Lemma 4.4.7, which claims a lift for every cyclic quotient but holds, is proved and is used only for quotients of prime order (E13), and four misprints. Routes 1, 3 and 6 are corrected in place; all six are accepted. Route 1 gains RD.5, route 3 moves from AN.4 to FunctionFieldArithmetic FA.5, and route 6's brief states its theorems exactly. Remark 3.1.7 is no longer an item, item 71 is added, and twenty items have statement, planned or note fixes; the result has 70 items (63 missing, 7 planned). For the orchestrator: links needed, none closing a cycle: CrystallineCohomology:CR.3 → RD.3 and → R07.2, VectorBundlesAndIsocrystals:VB0 → RD.3; CR.7 and R07.2 disagree about where the Dieudonné crystal is built; KloostermanSheavesAndBesselIsocrystals should import Crew's monodromy groups from route 6.
